Designed for Readers, Listeners & Everyday Comfort

Everything you need to enjoy RaggieSoft offline—and nothing getting in your way.

✨ Zero Sign-Ins, Zero Background Bloat

RaggieSoft Launcher only runs when you open it—never sitting in your system tray, never asking for an email account, and never interrupting your day with pop-ups.

⚡ Express Setup or Custom Control

Every RaggieSoft setup wizard lets you pick one-click Express Setup for sensible defaults, or Custom Setup to choose your exact folder, shortcuts, and file preferences.

🛡️ Your Offline Library Always Stays Safe

Updating or removing an app never deletes your downloaded books, music albums, reading preferences, or saved game profiles unless you explicitly check the box to clear them.

Applications Managed by RaggieSoft Launcher

Install only the ones you want—or enjoy their instant web editions right in your browser anytime.

Books & Interactive Novels

📖 RaggieSoft Book Reader

Ocean View Archives & Story Crossroads. Read every Ocean View Archives novel and interactive Story Crossroads adventure offline on your computer with adjustable font sizes, warm reading themes, full-color illustrations, and one-click chapter soundtracks.

  • Download complete novels with artwork for airplane, commuter, or cabin offline reading.
  • Customize text size, line spacing, and Daylight, Sepia, or Night reading palettes.
  • Jump straight into chapter songs in The Listening Room or bonus notes in Backstage without losing your page.
Open Web Edition (books.raggiesoft.com) → Explore Story Crossroads
Music & Sing-Along Lyrics

🎧 The Listening Room

Engine Room Records. Stream or save full Engine Room Records albums on your desktop with gapless playback, synchronized line-by-line lyrics, album liner notes, and keyboard media controls.

  • Save favorite albums from The Stardust Engine, Crimson Node, Firelight, and more for offline listening.
  • Watch lyrics highlight in time with the vocals—or jump to any verse by clicking a line.
  • Plays seamlessly alongside RaggieSoft Book Reader when exploring soundtrack-paired chapters.

Behind the Scenes & Story Arcs

🎬 RaggieSoft Backstage

RaggieSoft Media Bonus Features. Like the bonus-features disc inside a favorite box set: explore behind-the-scenes essays, character correspondence, curated multi-book Story Arcs, and standalone alternate-path stories.

  • Browse spoiler-marked commentary and production stories organized by book and musical era.
  • Follow guided Story Arcs across interconnected novels in chronological order.
  • Opens instantly when clicking a Bonus Feature card inside RaggieSoft Book Reader.

PC Games & Trainers

🕹️ RaggieSoft StoreTrainer 2.0

PC Game & Trainer Organizer. Keep your classic and modern PC games paired with their companion trainers, downloaded trainer ZIP archives, pre-launch save-game backups, and floating shortcut key cheat cards.

  • Launch with your chosen trainer—or click "Launch Game Only (No Trainer)" anytime for standard play.
  • Extract trainer ZIP files straight into your game folder, view classic ASCII info files, and pop out an Always-On-Top Cheat Card.
  • Includes a 3-step StoreFile Upgrade Wizard that imports classic StoreTrainer 1.0 & 1.1 profiles while leaving your originals untouched.
Visit StoreTrainer Portal → View Open-Source Archive
Retro PC Preservation

💾 StoreTrainer Classic (v1.1 Retro Edition)

Vintage Windows 95 – 2000 Preservation. Built for collectors running real vintage Windows 95, Windows 98, or Windows 2000 gaming PCs—and automatically recognized by RaggieSoft Launcher when installed on modern PCs too.

  • Preserves the lightweight classic design Michael originally hand-built inside Windows 2000.
  • Saves classic My StoreFiles profiles that remain 100% compatible between v1.0 and v1.1.
  • Automatically disables internet update checks when installed on offline vintage PCs.
